contract.test.mjs.source:
import { test, expect } from 'vitest'
import { choose } from './subject.mjs'
test('only true branch is executed', () => expect(choose(true)).toBe(1))

full.test.mjs.source:
import { test, expect } from 'vitest'
import { fully } from './fully.mjs'
test('fully covered control', () => expect(fully(2)).toBe(3))

failed.case.mjs.source:
import { test, expect } from 'vitest'
test('failed body still owns complete coverage', () => expect(1).toBe(2))

editSource:
import {test,expect} from 'vitest'
import {writeFileSync}from'node:fs'
test('edit actual formatter configuration',()=>{writeFileSync('vitest.config.mjs',process.env.FORMATTER_EDIT_SOURCE);expect(1).toBe(1)})
